history.overview: Dranik’s Scar was created when Discord energy tore open the land during the Muramite invasion.

timeline.name: Dragorn Homeland
timeline.description: The region was once a Dragorn plateau dotted with outposts and cliffside settlements.

timeline.name: Discord Rupture
timeline.description: Discord energy ripped open the land, forming the massive canyon known as Dranik’s Scar.

timeline.name: Muramite Occupation
timeline.description: Muramite armies seized the canyon and established forward war camps.

timeline.name: Resistance Raids
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels launched guerrilla attacks from hidden cliff alcoves.

timeline.name: Current Era
timeline.description: The Scar remains the primary surface warfront of Kuua, linking all major conflict zones.
